EXTREME_STAGE_CONDITION_ENEMY_HP.en: When the enemy tower's HP falls below %d%

EXTREME_STAGE_PASSIVE_ext_pas_agi_0001.zh: 參加戰鬥的敏捷型Ranger的攻擊力、防禦力和體力降低%N%。
EXTREME_STAGE_PASSIVE_ext_pas_agi_0001.en: The ATK, DEF and HP of Agility-type Rangers participating in battle decrease by %N%.

EXTREME_STAGE_PASSIVE_ext_pas_cooltime_0.zh: Ranger的重新產生時間會隨時間經過持續惡化，每隔%s秒將使Ranger生產累積條的回復速度降低%N%，效果會持續累積至戰鬥結束。
EXTREME_STAGE_PASSIVE_ext_pas_cooltime_0.en: Ranger redeployment time worsens over time. Every %s seconds, the recovery speed of the Ranger deployment gauge decreases by %N%. This effect stacks until the battle ends.
